output.objection: You are treating my concession on the audit scope as a free pass to ignore the cost of rework. If we slow the leaflet cycle to satisfy a full audit, the margin loss on the promotion week will dwarf any compliance gain.
output.correction: I did not say the audit is optional, I said the current partial review is the ceiling we can afford without breaking the buyer schedule. Do not file this as a request to cut corners, it is a hard constraint on our operational tempo.
